headline: Why do I keep picking non-committal men?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The cards were hidden, but your hand found the one who decides what others see.
He stands behind a table arranged openly in front of him.
You asked why you keep picking non-committal men. What catches me is how carefully the table is presented.
The men you chose did not commit, and the pattern has turned back on your choice.
Something sits between what is presented and commitment. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You chose without seeing him and found the card with only one side facing you.
His front faces you, while his arms remain behind him.
You asked why the men you choose do not commit. This card makes me look at the one side you can see.
Still, the men you chose did not commit, and the question has turned back on you.
Whatever has hold of the future keeps part of it out of view. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding the future…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing revealed the picture, yet your hand went to the one carrying very little at the start.
One small bundle is tied to the stick over his shoulder.
You asked why commitment stays unsettled after you choose. The small bundle is the part I notice first.
But the beginnings did not become commitment, and you are asking why you chose them.
Something appears just where a beginning would need to settle. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind this…
